payload.task_text:
I manage the purchasing department for our online store and I need to set up restock alerts for products that are running low on inventory. Please pull the complete product catalog from our e-commerce platform and identify every product that is currently out of stock, meaning the stock quantity is zero.

For each out-of-stock product, I need you to create a calendar reminder so we do not forget to reorder. The calendar event should be scheduled on March 10, 2026, from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM in the America/New_York timezone. The event title should be "Restock: [Product Name]" where the product name is truncated to the first 50 characters if it is longer than that. The description should read "Product ID: [ID]. SKU: [SKU]. Category: [Category Name]. This product is currently out of stock and needs to be reordered." Use the first category name listed for each product. If a product has no category, write "Uncategorized" as the category.

After creating the calendar events, send a single summary email from purchasing@ourstore.com to warehouse@ourstore.com with the subject "Out of Stock Alert - March 2026". The email body should list each out-of-stock product on its own line in the format "ID [Product ID]: [Product Name] (SKU: [SKU])" sorted by product ID ascending. At the bottom of the email, include a line that says "Total out-of-stock products: [N]" where N is the count.

Also save a plain text file called out_of_stock_report.txt in the workspace. Each line should contain "[Product ID] - [Product Name] - [SKU] - [Category]" for the out-of-stock products with each field separated by space-dash-space, sorted by product ID ascending.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, complete it directly in the main agent; do not dispatch sub-agents. Query the WooCommerce product endpoint with the out-of-stock filter at its maximum page size and retain only rows whose literal `stock_quantity` is `0`. Sort the verified list by numeric product ID and derive the report, events, and email from that one list. Write `out_of_stock_report.txt` once. In one native-parallel batch, search the exact 2026-03-10 09:00–10:00 America/New_York interval for every required `Restock: ...` title, create only missing events, and read each resulting event by ID. Then send exactly one email from `purchasing@ourstore.com` to `warehouse@ourstore.com` with subject `Out of Stock Alert - March 2026`, one sorted product line per item, and the exact total-count line.

nodes.text:
Create exactly 5 calendar events in Google Calendar using the `mcp__google_calendar__create_event` tool. These are restock reminders for out-of-stock products.

COMMON EVENT SCHEDULE (identical for all 5 events):
- Start: 2026-03-10T09:00:00 with timeZone "America/New_York"
- End: 2026-03-10T10:00:00 with timeZone "America/New_York"
- (No recurrence, no attendees, no location needed)

THE 5 EVENTS — use these EXACT `summary` (title) and `description` strings verbatim. Copy them character-for-character, including the special characters (® and ‑ U+2011 non-breaking hyphen) and trailing spaces where present. Do NOT re-derive, re-truncate, or "clean up" any of these strings.

EVENT 1:
- summary: "Restock: Infinity (JBL Glide 500, 20 Hrs Playtime with Quic"
- description: "Product ID: 20. SKU: INFINITY-JBL-GLIDE-1020. Category: Electronics. This product is currently out of stock and needs to be reordered."

EVENT 2:
- summary: "Restock: BOXTUDIO®- LIGHTBOX- Tabletop Portable PhotoStudio"
- description: "Product ID: 39. SKU: BOXTUDIO-LIGHTBOX-TA-1039. Category: Cameras. This product is currently out of stock and needs to be reordered."

EVENT 3 (note: the title ends with a trailing space character):
- summary: "Restock: TYPE-C Earphone for OnePlus 8 Pro , OnePlus Eight "
- description: "Product ID: 45. SKU: TYPEC-EARPHONE-FOR-1045. Category: Audio. This product is currently out of stock and needs to be reordered."

EVENT 4:
- summary: "Restock: 30kg digital scale for shop and kitchen green disp"
- description: "Product ID: 71. SKU: 30KG-DIGITAL-SCALE-1071. Category: Home Appliances. This product is currently out of stock and needs to be reordered."

EVENT 5 (note: contains a U+2011 non-breaking hyphen in "Sound‑Absorption"):
- summary: "Restock: Silencer Panels, Flame Retardant Sound‑Absorption,"
- description: "Product ID: 79. SKU: SILENCER-PANELS-FLAM-1079. Category: TV & Home Theater. This product is currently out of stock and needs to be reordered."

NOTES:
- The title format is "Restock: " + the product name truncated to its first 50 characters. The strings above are already correctly truncated — all summaries after the "Restock: " prefix are exactly 50 characters. Use them as-is.
- After creating all 5 events, verify each one by calling `mcp__google_calendar__list_events` for the range 2026-03-10T00:00:00Z to 2026-03-11T00:00:00Z and confirm 5 events exist with the correct titles and descriptions.

DELIVERABLE TO RETURN:
1. Confirmation that all 5 events were created.
2. The eventId of each of the 5 events, mapped to its product ID (20, 39, 45, 71, 79).
3. The verification result from list_events showing the 5 events on March 10, 2026.
4. Any errors encountered.

Do NOT create any events other than these 5. Do NOT send any emails.
Create 5 restock calendar events
